domain.description: URL users and Bitwarden clients reach Vaultwarden at, such as https://vault.example.com; browsers open the web vault only over https

signupsAllowed.description: Let anyone who reaches Vaultwarden create an account

adminToken.description: Enables the /admin page; an Argon2 PHC string from `vaultwarden hash`, or a plain token

port.description: Vaultwarden's HTTP port. When exposed with EXPOSE_VIP, keep it different from the exposed port (80) and set it as target_port

settings.description: Extra Vaultwarden environment variables, applied after the block's own, such as {"SMTP_HOST": "mail.example.com"}
